overview_description.description:
At Secret Escapes, they negotiate exclusive rates for luxury hand-picked hotels and holidays in the UK and abroad, at up to 60% off the price you'd pay by booking anywhere else. How have they done it? Well, even the most luxurious hotels out there don't like having empty rooms...

For access to their members-only rates, all you have to do is sign up to Secret Escapes with your email address and nothing else. It doesn't cost a penny, and never will.

In return, they will give you access to rates for hotels and holidays you'll struggle to find anywhere else, and if you do they will match their price - that's a guarantee.

about_short_description.short_description: Secret Escapes is a members-only travel club offering discounted rates on luxury hotels and holidays in the UK.

product.name: Members-Only Travel Club
product.description: A subscription-based service providing access to discounted rates on selected hotels and holidays in the UK and abroad.

product.name: Hotel-Only Bookings
product.description: Booking service for hotel stays without travel, offering refundable and non-refundable options with varying cancellation policies.

product.name: Package Holidays with Flights
product.description: Holiday packages combining hotel stays with flights, protected under ATOL, with booking and management through Secret Escapes.

product.name: Secret Escapes Flexible Holidays
product.description: Holiday packages provided directly by Secret Escapes allowing date changes up to 7 or 14 days before departure with partial refunds.

product.name: Trusted Partner Flexible Holidays
product.description: Holiday packages supplied by third-party operators with their own payment and cancellation policies, booked via Secret Escapes.

product.name: Mobile App for Travel Booking
product.description: A mobile application for iOS and Android that allows members to browse, shortlist, save, and book travel deals on the go, including offline access.
